about: Barcode reference cases. tools/make-barcode-references.py encodes each with zint 2.16.0 (zint-grids.json) and reads Egami's rendering of each back with zxing-cpp 3.1.1 (zxing-readback.json); Egami.Barcodes.Tests compares Egami's modules with zint's. 'call' is the Egami factory, 'data' its input, 'options' its options; 'zint' is the zint symbology, options, input mode, ECI and input (absent where only the read-back is checked); 'text' is the human-readable text, and 'read' what zxing-cpp returns when it differs (UPC-A as a GTIN-13, UPC-E expanded to one, Aztec Runes as three digits).
